name: AUZiX ESXi workstation media validation
intent: Validate AUZiX as a graphical/media workstation guest on ESXi, with emphasis on video, input, audio, and remote support behavior.

vm_shape.name: auzix-esxi-workstation-media-01
vm_shape.video_preference: VMware SVGA/vmwgfx or modesetting path with stable Enlightenment compositing; 3D acceleration is a bonus only when the ESXi host/client path exposes it
vm_shape.audio_preference: Expose an HDA-compatible virtual audio device when available; otherwise validate audio through remote-support tooling such as RustDesk

boot_requirements: initramfs attempts vmw_pvscsi for VMware paravirtual storage
initramfs attempts vmxnet3 for VMware paravirtual networking
SSH/TUI recovery remains available even if graphics fails
graphical_requirements: VMware SVGA/DRM path attempts vmwgfx when PCI vendor 0x15ad is detected
If ESXi does not expose guest 3D acceleration, validation focuses on compositor stability, resolution changes, and software-rendered desktop responsiveness
X11 can start with the existing AUZiX display stack
LightDM accepts keyboard and mouse input
resolution changes do not wedge the desktop session
media_requirements: audio device is detected when ESXi VM hardware exposes HDA-compatible audio
ALSA/PulseAudio session starts without root-owned user state
Firefox or Flatpak browser can render a page
Clementine or another media player can see user music files
LibreOffice Impress can open a sample deck visibly

remote_support_targets.placement: BKC/lab service first, AUZiX native package later
remote_support_targets.notes: Self-hosted hbbs/hbbr lane for controlled remote desktop rendezvous/relay.

remote_support_targets.placement: AUZiX workstation package; Flatpak/AppImage adapter acceptable as a bridge before native Rust build
remote_support_targets.notes: Candidate remote desktop path for smoother filming/support than noVNC, with audio and basic accelerated desktop rendering as validation goals.

non_goals: Do not make ESXi guest polish a tiny-netinstall requirement
Do not require RustDesk or open-vm-tools before base install proof
Do not treat noVNC/Proxmox behavior as proof of ESXi media behavior
